rationale.hitl-workflow: Plan approvals, action guards, pausing, intervention, and control handoffs.
rationale.risk-routing: Independent heuristics and LLM judge select actions requiring human approval.
rationale.ai-review: LLM ActionGuard probabilistically judges proposed actions for risk and irreversibility.
rationale.rules-based-checks: Heuristics, allow-lists, and Docker sandboxes provide deterministic safeguards.
rationale.oversight-explanation: Histories, screenshots, progress indicators, and summaries support human verification.
rationale.automation-bias: Users trusted outputs despite recognizing uncertainty or flawed procedures.
